description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeReportingMethodDao component of the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing data access operations related to employee reporting relationships, such as subordinates and supervisors.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeReportingMethodDao data access object, verifying functionalities like retrieving supervisors/subordinates, counting, searching, saving, and deleting reporting relationships.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodDao and loading test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers_WhenReportToAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieving a reporting relationship when it exists.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers_WhenReportToNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests the retrieval when no reporting relationship exists.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount_WhenSubordinatesAvailable
methods.description: Verifies counting subordinates when they exist.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount_WhenSubordinatesNotAvailable
methods.description: Verifies counting subordinates when none exist.

methods.name: testGetSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount_WhenSupervisorsAvailable
methods.description: Verifies counting supervisors when they exist.

methods.name: testGetSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount_WhenSupervisorsNotAvailable
methods.description: Verifies counting supervisors when none exist.

methods.name: testSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors_WhenSupervisorsNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests searching for immediate supervisors when none are available.

methods.name: testSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors_WhenSupervisorsAvailable
methods.description: Tests searching for immediate supervisors when available.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSubordinates_WhenSubordinatesAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieving subordinates with available data.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSubordinates_WhenSubordinatesNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieving subordinates when none are present.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Tests deletion of supervisor relationships for an employee.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Tests deletion of subordinate relationships for an employee.
